description: This file defines functions and logic related to the Activity class, including a method to instantiate an Activity object from a protocol buffer object, and a helper to add attributes. It also exports the Activity class.

classes.name: Activity
classes.description: A class representing an activity, with methods to instantiate from protocol buffer data.

methods.name: Activity.fromProto
methods.description: Creates an Activity instance from a protobuf object, processing window container and other properties.

methods.name: function addAttributes(entry: Activity, proto: any) { addAttributes
methods.description: Adds metadata attributes to an Activity instance based on the protobuf object.
